page.layout: One column of italic verse lines, centred on the page; running head at top; page number top right; signature-like mark "L." below the text at centre; catchword "Fluminis" at lower right. Faint show-through from the reverse side in the right margin, not transcribed.

p.i: Valis ubi Rheno vadit disjectus, eadem
Valis habet dextram, sed jam Lendina fluentis
Ut quatuor passus mille peregit iter.
Insula finitur medio dum limite Valis
Latius advecta subigit dum Najade fluctus
Rhenus ab insultu Cori divertit ad arctum
Solis ad occasum declinat flumine Rhenus
Hinc reperit Corum, fossa dissectus hianti,
Laevus ad Hussenia moenia Rhenus agit.
Solis ab occasu partim curvatur in austros
Quando decem passus mille peregit iter.
Hoc sedium laeva simulat accessit eundo
Dicta suo spectat jam nomina moenia Rhenus,
Vichia praluftri nobilis amne sita est.
Lecca cadit Rheno tenui sed egentior amne,
Quae tulerat, Rheno flumina dante tulit.
Ut stadiis centum fertur liquisse Viandam
Ceu meruit, pelagi Lecca subintrat aquas.
Parte facit dextra Vechtam, rimatur agellos
Et tenui Vechtam fossa liquore vehit.

page.notes: Show-through from the reverse page is visible in the right margin and was omitted. Large decorative woodcut initial at the centre-right is not a letter of text. Several words are uncertain in the scan (e.g. "Lendina", "Isalasceducto", "Eltenium", "prapete", "praluftri"); they are copied as best read.
